objective: Test whether compact VPD mechanism controls add visible value beyond direct use of the same approved reference in the same ChatGPT Images renderer.

new_content_task.subject: A real working rice granary in early morning: pale rice grains, woven baskets, linen sacks, aged wood bins, and a modest sorting/preparation surface.
new_content_task.realism: Believable documentary photography with cool-neutral morning daylight and truthful materials.

route_A.prompt: Create exactly one native 3:4 portrait, photo-only editorial hero for a new content task: a working rice granary at early morning. Show pale rice grains, woven baskets, linen sacks, aged wood bins and a modest sorting/preparation surface in believable documentary photography with cool-neutral morning daylight; no mountains or forest, tea ware, wok or flame, calligraphy, logos, labels, final text, or detached text panels. Use the attached approved R1C reference only as a family-level visual/style anchor—not to copy its subject, brand identity, typography, motifs, or layout coordinates—and leave one natural quiet area for later Figma typography.

route_B.prompt: Create exactly one native 3:4 portrait, photo-only editorial hero for a new content task: a working rice granary at early morning. Show pale rice grains, woven baskets, linen sacks, aged wood bins and a modest sorting/preparation surface in believable documentary photography with cool-neutral morning daylight; no mountains or forest, tea ware, wok or flame, calligraphy, logos, labels, final text, or detached text panels. Use the attached approved R1C reference only as a family-level visual/style anchor—not to copy its subject, brand identity, typography, motifs, or layout coordinates. In addition, enforce these compact distilled mechanisms: (1) one dominant material mass counterbalanced by a scene-created quiet tonal pocket for future title; (2) a clear first-to-second-to-third read through mass, depth, and support detail; (3) high material detail concentrated regionally while the future-type pocket stays low-density; (4) truthful near/mid/far depth staging; (5) pale grain, linen and aged wood with cool-neutral shadow as role-based color behavior rather than palette copying; (6) semantic-role binding so rice, baskets, sacks and tools function as real process/material evidence rather than decorative motifs.

ab_symmetry.only_difference: Route B adds six compact distilled mechanism controls.

human_review.first_question: Which image is more usable as a visual direction: X, Y, both, or neither?
human_review.second_question: If one is better, what visible reason makes it better?

stop_conditions: wrong reference identity or more than one reference image
visible generation produced but hidden retry would be needed
Route B needs extra manual edit budget to look competitive
non_conclusions: Stage 1 does not promote Style Capsule.
A single B win does not prove stable transfer.
An A win does not invalidate prior accepted assets.
